h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Siwan

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Siwan

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Siwan

c: A gram panchayat ground, a school compound or a small town park in Siwan can all hold an open gym, as long as the base and the choice of machines are right. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Siwan, in the Saran division of north Bihar. We make the machines at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,400 km away, and deliver them to Bihar by road.

The plains here are hot in May and June, wet through the monsoon and cool in winter. Our galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts are made for that kind of year-round outdoor use. Before we quote, we ask for the size of the ground, photos and the people who will use it. We then send a layout drawing, and our team or a dealer in eastern India installs the machines after approval.

richText.heading: What to budget for besides the machines

c: Buyers sometimes plan only for the equipment. Set aside money for the concrete pad, drainage around it and, if you want, rubber flooring under the stations. Grouting the posts into concrete is the steadier option on soft alluvial soil.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gyms to small towns and villages in Bihar?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai to any location in India. Our installation team or a dealer in the eastern region sets up the machines on site.

items.q: What site work do we need to do before installation?
items.a: Usually a level concrete pad of the size shown on our layout drawing, with drainage around it. We share the pad details before dispatch so the work can be done in advance.

items.q: Can you supply rubber flooring as well?
items.a: Yes. We supply rubber flooring along with the equipment. It gives a firmer, less slippery surface than bare concrete during the monsoon.
